description: Create one payment link using quote_id and color for one part, or items with a color for each part. For several models, bundle them in one call so the customer pays once with one shipping charge. They enter their shipping address on the linked page. Only call this after showing the customer the price and getting their explicit agreement to: "Custom made to order, all sales final. I agree to the Terms (mandarin3d.com/terms, including section 6: cancellations, refunds and reprints)."

customer_accepted_terms.description: True only if the customer explicitly agreed to the terms sentence above.

items.description: Parts to ship in one order. Use qty for repeated copies of the same quote, color and material. Do not mix items with top-level print fields.

material.description: "pla" (default) or "petg". PETG is made to order in black or white: we order the filament after you buy, which adds 3 to 5 business days, and the print price is 20% higher. We print in PLA and PETG only. PETG is the tougher option.

cleanup.description: +$5. Supports removed and sharp edges deburred.
